sloka: ज्वलन्तं तेजसा नित्यं क्रोधेन च दुरासदम्।कस्तं मृत्युमिवासह्यमासादयितुमर्हति ।। ६.६४.१५ ।।
transliteration: jvalantaṁ tejasā nityaṁ krodhena ca durāsadam।kastaṁ mṛtyumivāsahyamāsādayitumarhati ।। 6.64.15 ।।

translations.english: "Who can dare to approach Rama, who is difficult to encounter, unbearable and burning in anger like the spirit of death."
